rules.title: RevenueDot iOS SDK
rules.description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's iOS SDK, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install with CocoaPods (pod 'RevenueDotPurchases', plus 'RevenueDotPurchasesUI' for paywalls) or Swift Package Manager from https://github.com/revenuedot/purchases-ios.
Swift Package Manager tags are the upstream version followed by -revenuedot, and the products are named RevenueCat and RevenueCatUI.
Keep `import RevenueCat` and `import RevenueCatUI`: the module names and every class and method name match the RevenueCat iOS SDK.
RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, set `Purchases.proxyURL = URL(string: "https://revenuedot.example.com")!` before `Purchases.configure(withAPIKey:)`.
Pass the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard (it starts with appl_) to `Purchases.configure(withAPIKey:)`.

rules.note: main API, web billing, remote config source, test-only force-failure URL
fallback host; our API serves /v1/offerings too

rules.title: RevenueDot iOS SDK
install: pod 'RevenueDotPurchasesUI', '{{version}}'   # only if you use RevenueCatUI
// Package.swift, or Xcode > Add Package Dependencies
The modules stay `RevenueCat` and `RevenueCatUI`, so `import RevenueCat` does not change.

code: // Self-hosted server only: RevenueDot Cloud ({{apiHost}}) is the default.
Purchases.configure(withAPIKey: "appl_...")   // the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard

checks.name: podspec parse
checks.run: for f in RevenueDotPurchases.podspec RevenueDotPurchasesUI.podspec; do LANG=en_US.UTF-8 pod ipc spec "$f" 2>/dev/null | node -e 'const s=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8"));console.log(s.name,"module",s.module_name,"tag",s.source.tag,"deps",JSON.stringify(s.dependencies||{}))' || exit 1; done

checks.name: swift build (macOS, RevenueCat target)
checks.run: free=$(df -k . | awk 'NR==2{print $4}'); if [ "$free" -lt 8000000 ]; then echo "SKIPPED: swift build needs ~8 GB free disk, $((free/1024)) MB free"; exit 0; fi; swift build --target RevenueCat 2>&1 | tail -5; exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}
